name: Potion Infusion: Seal rests target Potion and tags it INFUSION_SEAL
notes: Potion Infusion: Seal's element is WATER, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real WATER champion (Spirit of Water) to unlock element access. Distilled Water (a POTION-subtype ITEM) is seeded directly onto the field as the rest target, since PotionInfusionSealResolve only searches myField for ready (Status 2) POTION objects. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid, then both players decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window before the seeded Potion is chosen. Resting it adds the INFUSION_SEAL turn-effect tag; only the base rest+tag effect is covered, not the granted On-Sacrifice-Negate ability itself (which requires actually sacrificing the Potion).

rulesClauses: Rest target Potion. If you do, it gains "On Sacrifice: Negate target card activation unless its controller pays (2)" until end of turn.
